verdict.rationale: Data region or residency selection is a fair question for a SaaS observability platform, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack documents a region choice, data center selection, or residency control for New Relic. The community comments about latency for non-US users and demand for on-prem APM only voice concerns and do not show any such capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
